title: Local Wikipedia: Wikipedia, but only for things a half hour walk from you
why_read: A fun, well-executed niche mapping project that's technically light but creatively interesting to engineers who like geo/data hacks.
analysis: This is a project that filters Wikipedia's 'nearby places' data down to only things within walking distance of a given point. It's a small, clever application of existing geo-data rather than a new technical breakthrough. The appeal is mostly in the idea and execution rather than any novel engineering, but it shows a nice use of open data and mapping APIs. High engagement likely reflects its fun, personal, exploratory nature more than deep technical substance.
